case.summary: The website explains the current Windows modules, the responsibilities of Operação, Rotinas and Consulta, and the new web version of Operador under validation.
case.role: Product direction, content architecture, responsive design and publication of the ClubAL website.
case.evidence: A live website in Portuguese, English and Spanish, with light and dark themes, responsive layout, local assets and no browsing analytics.

tabs.label: Challenge
tabs.title: Present an evolving product clearly.
tabs.body: The content begins with the problem, explains how recording, publishing and consultation relate, and identifies the new web version of Operador as an evolution still under validation.

tabs.label: Architecture
tabs.title: The narrative follows the product architecture.
tabs.body: Operação, Rotinas and Consulta form the current base. The new web version of Operador is under validation and includes the weather forecast.
